reason: A DeepSeek Harness Web UI plugin that provides a bookmarkable, turn-grouped conversation timeline with history loading, navigation controls, and responsive mobile support.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 提供按对话回合组织的可收藏时间线面板，支持消息跳转、历史加载、键盘操作和移动端使用。
summaries.en: Provides DeepSeek Harness Web UI with a bookmarkable, turn-grouped conversation timeline supporting message navigation, history loading, keyboard controls, and mobile use.

capabilities: Displays a conversation timeline overlay in the DeepSeek Harness Web UI
Groups and navigates chat messages by turn
Loads older conversation messages when needed for navigation
Stores bookmarks and user interface preferences locally
Provides keyboard, touch, and responsive mobile-panel controls
